note: The open registry of harness root causes (ORB-163 D5a). Adding a root is a one-line edit to this file, made in the SAME pull request as the ticket that needs it. tools/check-ticket.mjs reads it and never writes it; the /ticket and /feature skills perform the append. The id 'exempt' is reserved, claims no root, and must not be registered here. Seeded from the brain-vault ADR 'The harness root-cause taxonomy is an open registry not a closed list of four' (2026-07-31).

roots.definition: a tool reports an outcome it never verified, deriving it from its own transport result, cache or exit code rather than from an authoritative external source
a worker stops before its contract is met and the run records the stop as completion
a gate keyed on a STRING in a payload instead of the ACT it is meant to govern
state read from a source nothing keeps current, such as a working copy instead of the authoritative ref
an agent invents an external interface, then writes the stub that agrees with it, so the harness proves the belief rather than the behaviour
